app.title: Trading Journal
app.description: Trade journal for prop-firm futures traders

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Open a page, run an action, switch the account or the theme
palette.placeholder: Type a page, an action, an account or a theme…

auth.timezoneHint: The clock you sit in front of while trading.
auth.usernameHint: This is how you sign in. It can't be changed.
auth.registrationClosed: New accounts can't be created here.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Pick another.
auth.createFailed: Couldn't create the account. Try again.
auth.totpPrompt: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.

auth.totpMismatch: That code didn't match. Codes change every 30 seconds — try the current one.
auth.backupMismatch: That backup code didn't match, or it was used already.

language.hint: The language of the app. What you typed stays as you wrote it.
language.demoHint: On the demo account the language applies to this browser only.
